hooks.name: Keep docs in sync on task completion
hooks.description: Keep docs and reports in sync when a spec task is completed

action.prompt: A spec task was just completed. Update the README results tables and any affected file in `reports/` so documentation reflects the current code and metrics. If `reports/evaluation.json` exists, regenerate the model card via the `model-card` skill. Never invent numbers — read them from `reports/evaluation.json`. Keep the executive summary's headline as a dollar figure.
